findings.finding: The source manifests live outside root/source inventories and are not separately reopened against initial physical+SHA pins after archiving.
findings.location: source manifest bootstrap and terminal preservation
findings.minimal_correction: Read each bounded regular manifest through its admitted FD; retain its exact initial physical facts and SHA, parse/embed those same bytes, then reopen/digest and compare the original pin before emitting receipt.

findings.finding: The member FD identity is only compared to its own later fstat, not to the selected inventory row; subsequent digest(p) hashes a reopened name rather than the exact emitted stream.
findings.minimal_correction: Compare opened FD physical facts to the original row before tar.addfile. Wrap that FD reader to hash/count every exact tar-supplied byte; require matching full SHA/size and stable FD/name facts. Keep complete final source inventory equality.

findings.finding: Pinned digest and parsed reference-check body come from separate reads.
findings.minimal_correction: Use one bounded stable ordinary opened-body helper for both current control pin and parsed JSON.

other_scoped_checks: Original directory/file membership including empty directories, modes/uid/gid/nlink1, actual64GiB/swap0/current boot and leaf, compressed stream SHA+bytes, and explicit no-unlink receipt scope were read; caller must independently validate/fsync archive before retirement.
scope: Source read, AST and SHA only. No candidate imports, archive execution, SSH, tests or source retirement.
